notes.title: War Of Castles Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello!
This is the first update for War Of Castles. The specific update content is as follows:
[list]
[*] New Creative Workshop: Now custom maps can be added to the Creative Workshop!
[*] In custom maps, you can search for maps by type.
[*] New Steam Achievements
[*] New Pre-battle Buff Selection
[*] New Building: Statue: Each faction can have up to one statue. Different types of statues will provide special effects to different units.
[*] 5 New Statue-related Playable Levels
[/list]

We are continuously developing future versions! You can check our update roadmap. If you're interested in our game, feel free to purchase it or add it to your wishlist!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828429/82bf9d2cd2d46861f4bd5dc84c50b03bf85fa9c6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Early Access to the real-time strategy game "War of Castles" is now available!
notes.content:
10% off for the first week!
Feel free to go to steam and buy or try out the free demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44828429/5439731a2495ac3bf82c0fc1f108ef6facc8a33f.png[/img]

The Early Access version of the game will feature 60 campaign levels, and player-customised maps can be uploaded to the game for other players to play through, as well as challenging maps customised by other players.

The game is expected to follow up with tentative update plans in the Early Access version including: updated Creative Workshop, more new buildings and troop types, optimised art iterations, addition of a weather system, multiplayer online mode Beat testing and more, so stay tuned!

notes.title: The free prologue of the real-time strategy game "War Of Castles" is available！
notes.content:
The free prologue of the real-time strategy game "War Of Castles" developed by Jim Chen and published by OKJOY, is now available! Compared to the demo, the game features 10 new levels and introduces a map editing function. Players can create custom maps and play them. After completing a map, they can upload it for other players to challenge! Likewise, you can try out maps uploaded by other players and solve the puzzles they’ve left behind.

We welcome everyone to experience the game and leave your feedback/add it to your wishlist. Barring any unforeseen issues, the game will be released as an Early Access (EA) version in August.

"War Of Castles : Prologue" Steam store page link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331100

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068725/4e402013dfa5800d1a87fcd8e7966e75cbd6cc42.png[/img]

Game Introduction
Conquer the enemy's castle! Capture all the islands! "War Of Castles" is a real-time strategy game centered around warfare. Players must lead their troops to capture castles on various islands and claim entire islands as their own. However, be wary of enemy backstabs while you are attacking their castles!

notes.title: The RTS game "War Of Castles" debuts a new demo at the Steam Next Fest！
notes.content:

From now until June 18 at 1:00 AM (CST), you can download the demo from the Steam store page. We will also be live streaming the game on the Steam homepage, so interested players can watch the stream or add it to their wishlist.
